displayName: OCI-API-013: API — JWT Token None Algorithm Attack
description:
Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: api — jwt token none algorithm attack

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_013", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%jwt%') AND "value" > 0
